issue.title: test_rust_dev_install_disables_cargo_incremental_cache: 6a60ee5fb7 widened the incremental rm -rf lines, stale exact-substring asserts
issue.description:
Commit 6a60ee5fb7 ('feat(managed-tmp): make reaper horizons and pressure limits
configurable', landed 2026-09-14, on origin/master) rewrote the Justfile
rust-dev-install incremental-cache cleanup lines from
`rm -rf "$py_target_dir/$profile/incremental"` (and the lsp twin) to
`rm -rf "$py_target_dir/build/$profile/incremental" "$py_target_dir/$profile/incremental"`
(Justfile:990, and Justfile:1001 for `$lsp_target_dir`), so both directories are still
removed and the behavior the test polices is intact — but
tests/test_justfile_lint.py::test_rust_dev_install_disables_cargo_incremental_cache
(lines 350-351) asserts the exact substrings
`rm -rf "$py_target_dir/$profile/incremental"` / `rm -rf "$lsp_target_dir/$profile/incremental"`
occur exactly once, and those substrings no longer appear because `rm -rf ` is now
followed by the build/ path first. `output.count(...)` returns 0 and the test fails.

Fix: update the two assertions to match the current combined rm lines (e.g. assert the
combined `rm -rf "$py_target_dir/build/$profile/incremental" "$py_target_dir/$profile/incremental"`
string, or a substring check per directory) so the test tracks what 6a60ee5fb7 actually
ships. The CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 count assertion on line 349 still passes.

Discovered during the sase-zn.9 rebase-conflict-repair verification (`just check` on
master 8bd8fb891d + the replayed commit); my diff touches only
src/sase/core/managed_tmp_reaper.py and tests/test_axe_chop_output_contract.py, never
the Justfile or tests/test_justfile_lint.py.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic string assertion over a just --dry-run of the rust-dev-install recipe: the Justfile text on master no longer contains the exact substrings the test counts, so it fails identically on every run (reproduced in the full just check lane and twice in isolated reruns on an unchanged tree). Root cause is a specific landed commit (6a60ee5fb7) editing the lines the test pins.
